cards.b: Everyday activities: home, routine, school, food and drink, health.
Personal and social life: family, friends, hobbies, holidays, festivals.
The world around us: town, shopping, services, environment, weather, transport.
The world of work: further education, careers, part-time jobs, communication.
The international world: travel, tourism, life abroad, world issues.
Answer in French (answering in English loses the mark).

cards.f: Vrai ou faux ? Corrigez les phrases fausses
cards.b: True or false? Correct the false sentences.

cards.f: What is a distractor in Listening?
cards.b: Information that sounds like the answer but is not, e.g. a plan later cancelled (« mais finalement… »).

cards.f: Why must you wait for the final decision in Listening?
cards.b: Speakers change their minds; « Je voulais… mais finalement… » means the answer comes after « mais ».
Copying words from the text. Only copy the relevant part, not a whole sentence containing wrong extra information.

cards.f: What does a top Speaking/Writing answer include?
cards.b: Three time frames, opinions with reasons, connectives, one or two ambitious structures, and accurate basics.

cards.f: Give three French connectives with meanings
cards.b: cependant (however), donc (so), par contre (on the other hand), ensuite (next), pourtant (yet).

short.q: Name the four components of IGCSE French 0520 and say how much each is worth. [2]
short.model: Listening, Reading, Speaking and Writing, each worth 25%.

short.q: Listening: « Je voulais acheter un pantalon, mais il était trop cher, alors j'ai pris un tee-shirt. » What did she buy? Explain. [2]
short.model: She bought a t-shirt. The trousers were a distractor because they were too expensive.
points: Trousers were wanted but not bought / distractor (1)

short.q: Translate these exam instructions: (a) Répondez en français (b) Corrigez les phrases fausses. [2]
short.model: (a) Answer in French. (b) Correct the false sentences.

short.q: Explain why missing one bullet point in a Writing task is costly. [2]
short.model: Communication marks depend on covering every bullet clearly, so a missing bullet caps the communication mark.
points: Missing one caps the communication mark (1)

short.q: Improve this Speaking answer: « J'aime le sport. » Give three ways. [3]
short.model: Add a reason (parce que c'est rapide), add a past example (le week-end dernier, j'ai joué un match) and add a future plan (l'année prochaine, je voudrais m'inscrire dans un club).
